svg.title: Kimi K3 detailed architecture
svg.desc: Detailed official-corrected architecture of Kimi K3 covering Block Attention Residuals, Kimi Delta Attention, the hybrid language backbone, Stable LatentMoE, NoPE Gated MLA, and the MoonViT-V2 vision pathway.

g.text: 93 layers · block size 12 · 8 layer blocks + embedding source
First layer of a block reads completed blocks; later layers also read the current partial sum.
Sₜ ∈ ℝ¹²⁸×¹²⁸ per head · fixed size across sequence length
MTP: report table = 1 · released checkpoint config = 0
* Layer 1 replaces Stable LatentMoE with dense FFN.
896 routed experts · Top-16 · 2 shared experts · auxiliary-loss-free sigmoid routing
gate branch · tanh soft cap + sigmoid · β₁=4
up branch · tanh soft cap · β₂=25
q LoRA rank 1536 · kv LoRA/cache rank 512
No RoPE or positional cache path is used by K3 MLA.
401M parameters · trained from scratch · image/video parameters shared · next-token prediction objective
fully shared parameters for images and videos
image path uses the spatial pass
No separate post-hoc modality alignment stage.
lightweight projector into the text space
The public config names this projector `patchmergerv2`.
text, image, and video share one backbone context
Model architecture supports image and video.
Public self-hosted processor support can be narrower.

svg.text: Sources: Kimi K3 Technical Report §2 and the released Hugging Face config. The detailed figure omits the draft’s RoPE/PE-cache MLA path because K3 sets mla_use_nope=true.
